name: com.mypivots/mypivots
title: MyPivots Daily Notes
description: Pivot points, Crabel patterns and technicals for stocks, futures, forex, indices and crypto.

tools.name: daily_notes_query
tools.description: Query MyPivots Daily Notes for historical daily market analytics: pass namespaced symbols and calendar dates to fetch up to 100 (symbol × date) cells per call. Returns, per cell, the OHLCV bar with Classic/Woodie/Camarilla/DeMark/Fisher pivot points, Fibonacci retracements and extensions, Toby Crabel price-action patterns (NR4, NR7, ID, IDnr4, Stretch, etc.), moving averages, volatility and range statistics, RSI, and MACD. Every requested cell comes back: a cell with no data — an unknown symbol, or a date before the symbol's recorded history — returns with status "missing", null data, and a reason instead of failing the call; a date that falls on a non-trading day returns the nearest prior trading day, labeled by its tradingDate; a cell with limited price history returns the analytics that can be computed, with the remaining indicator fields null. Requests over 100 cells, or with malformed symbols or dates, fail with an error and return nothing. Use for historical, end-of-day analysis of specific symbols and dates; it does not provide real-time quotes, forecasts, or trading. Calls require a MyPivots Premium subscription or partner key.

dates.description: Array of calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. ["2026-09-23", "2026-09-24"]). A date that falls on a non-trading day returns the nearest prior trading day; a date before a symbol's recorded history returns a missing cell for that symbol.

symbols.description: Array of namespaced symbol strings: "stk:" stocks and ETFs, "fut:" futures, "idx:" indices, "fx:" or "forex:" currency pairs, "crypto:" crypto pairs (e.g. "stk:AAPL", "fut:ES", "fut:NQZ26", "idx:VIX", "fx:EURUSD", "crypto:BTCUSD"). An unrecognized symbol does not fail the call; its cells return as missing with a reason.
